warranty.notes: Australia and New Zealand (country group 3): 75% of usable energy (SOH) at 10 years or the energy throughput for the tower size, whichever comes first: Reserva Pro 12.0 44.52 MWh, Reserva Pro 16.0 59.36 MWh, Reserva Pro 20.0 74.2 MWh, Reserva Pro 24.0 89.04 MWh, Reserva Pro 28.0 103.88 MWh, Reserva Pro 32.0 118.72 MWh. The warranty doesn't say whether throughput is charged or discharged energy. Applies to purchases from 1 October 2026; the warranty period formally starts six months after delivery from Fronius (BatteryLedger counts from installation).

sources.title: Fronius International Limited Warranty Conditions, Battery (EN_0326; country group 3: Australia, New Zealand)

notes: Reserva Pro 12.0 to 32.0: 3-8 Reserva Pro modules per battery (3.98 kWh usable, about 4.0 kWh nominal, 99.5% depth of discharge); up to 4 batteries in parallel, one BatteryLedger battery group per battery. Primo GEN24 Plus (single-phase) supports the 12.0-20.0; Symo GEN24 Plus and Verto Plus all sizes.
